## Before submitting

- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [ ] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes. (`pre-commit` was not available on the machines used; the changed files were checked with `black -l 160 --check` and `pyflakes` instead.)
- [ ] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Summary

Block-sparse attention (`python/cudnn/block_sparse_attention`):

1. **Sage FP8 forward on Hopper (SM90), blk64 and blk128.** Native E4M3 QK and PV with a pretransposed BHDS V, FP32 softmax state and output accumulation. blk64 picks a double-buffered K/V schedule for small grids and a single-stage-K schedule for large ones from the launch geometry (one compiled entry, no recompilation); blk128 shares K/V across two warpgroups with overlapped QK/PV.
2. **Sage FP8 forward on SM100/SM103, blk128.** Row sum fused into the PV MMA; optional split-KV through the existing FP32 partial combine. Adapted from NVIDIA-JerryChen/Block-Sparse-Attention (f953680), as noted in the file header and docs.
3. **`kv_splits="auto"` for the SM90 blk64 BF16/FP16 forward** (default stays `kv_splits=1`, like SM100). Once one head's K/V exceeds L2, the unsplit kernel is DRAM-bound (H100 BF16, 128K: L2 hit 40%, DRAM 85%). Lists are ascending, so a split is a KV range and the split grid runs every Q tile of one range before the next. `auto` picks the smallest power of two that fits a split's per-head K/V in 3/4 of L2, and declines (one split) in unmeasured regimes: GQA, variable counts, dense lists (>25% density), too few Q tiles per head, a caller-provided `out`.
4. `benchmark/bsa/benchmark_sm90_fp8.py`: FP8 attention time and effective TFLOPS for blk64 and blk128.

`block_sparse_attention_fp8_forward` dispatches blk64 on SM90/SM120 and blk128 on SM90/SM100/SM103/SM120. The SM90 blk128 half-precision helpers move from `_sm90_blk128.py` into `_interface.py` so the SM90 paths share one compile-key and TMA-validation helper set (the only non-FP8 code motion).

## Why

Hopper had no FP8 path for block-sparse attention, and SM100/SM103 had no native FP8 blk128. `kv_splits="auto"` closes the SM90 BF16 blk64 bandwidth gap against blk128 on large sequences.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

- New private launchers `_bsa_attn_fwd_sm90_fp8_blk64/blk128` and `_bsa_attn_fwd_sm100_fp8_blk128`; the public `block_sparse_attention_fp8_forward` gains SM90 support and SM90/SM100/SM103 native blk128. `kv_splits` on that function applies to SM100/SM103 blk128 only.
- `block_sparse_attention_forward(..., kv_splits="auto")` is now accepted on SM90 (blk64). Default unchanged (`1`).
- Requires `nvidia-cutlass-dsl>=4.6.1` (SM90 FP8 blk64) / `>=4.6.2` (SM90 FP8 blk128, SM100/SM103 FP8 blk128), gated at runtime with a version-naming error.
- FP8 numerics: P is rounded to E4M3, so results differ from BF16 at the FP8 level; the tests compare against independent online references without widening tolerances.

Measured on H100 80GB (attention kernel only, CUDA graph replay, `benchmark_sm90_fp8.py --quick`): blk64 about 510-535 TFLOPS, blk128 about 620-650 TFLOPS at 8K sequence. `kv_splits` (BF16 blk64, random indices, 12.5% density): 64/128/256 MiB of K/V per head -> 2/4/8 splits, +20% / +70% / +94% over one split; dense lists lose 12% when split, so `auto` declines them.

## Testing

H100 80GB HBM3 (SM90):
- `cd test/python && pytest block_sparse_attention/cutedsl -m "L0 or L1"` -> 450 passed, 231 skipped.
- `test_BSA_attention_fp8_sm90.py` (blk64 and blk128 parametrized): 178 passed.
- `benchmark/bsa/benchmark_sm90_fp8.py --quick` runs.

B200 (SM100): same command -> 241 passed, 440 skipped; `test_BSA_attention_fp8_sm100_blk128.py` alone: 77 passed.

B300 (SM103): same command -> 240 passed, 441 skipped; `test_BSA_attention_fp8_sm100_blk128.py` alone: 77 passed.

The SM100/SM103 blk128 kernel went through a dead-code cleanup (GQA packing, non-TMA epilogue, static scheduler, single-CTA empty warp). The generated PTX before and after is byte-identical for fixed count, per-block sizes + counts, and split-KV configurations, on `sm_103a` and on cross-compiled `sm_100a`.

Not tested: SM120 hardware (those cases were skipped on all three machines; only a shared quantizer helper in `sm120_blk128/sage_v_quant.py` is touched). The DSL-preprocessor check from `python/cudnn/AGENTS.md` Rule 7 (rerun with `quack` imported first) was not run; `quack-kernels` was not installed on the test machines.

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Time the Hopper Sage FP8 block-sparse attention kernels (blk64 and blk128).
+
+Run with this checkout imported, for example:
+    PYTHONPATH=python python benchmark/bsa/benchmark_sm90_fp8.py --output /tmp/bsa-sm90-fp8.json
+
+Q/K/V are quantized once outside the timed region. Each block size gets its own random
+sparse graph with the same number of active KV tokens per query block, so the effective
+TFLOPS (4 * B * H * Sq * active_tokens * D, sparse QK and PV only) are comparable. Times
+are CUDA-event measurements of warmed CUDA graph replay of the attention kernel alone:
+they exclude quantization, JIT compilation, host allocation and Python launch overhead.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import statistics
+import subprocess
+
+import cutlass
+import cudnn
+import torch
+
+from cudnn.block_sparse_attention._fp8_quant import _quantize_sage_bhsd
+from cudnn.block_sparse_attention._interface import _bsa_attn_fwd_sm90_fp8_blk64, _bsa_attn_fwd_sm90_fp8_blk128
+
+HEAD_DIM = 128
+# (batch, heads, seqlen_q, seqlen_k, active KV tokens per query block)
+QUICK_SHAPES = [(1, 4, 256, 8192, 2048), (1, 8, 2048, 8192, 2048), (1, 8, 8192, 8192, 2048)]
+SHAPES = QUICK_SHAPES + [(2, 8, 8192, 8192, 384), (1, 4, 128, 32768, 8192), (1, 8, 32768, 32768, 2048)]
+KERNELS = {64: _bsa_attn_fwd_sm90_fp8_blk64, 128: _bsa_attn_fwd_sm90_fp8_blk128}
+
+
+def measure(fn, repeats, iterations):
+    """Median/min/max microseconds per call of one captured CUDA graph."""
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        for _ in range(3):
+            output = fn()
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream):
+            output = fn()
+        for _ in range(5):
+            graph.replay()
+        samples = []
+        for _ in range(repeats):
+            start, end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True), torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+            start.record()
+            for _ in range(iterations):
+                graph.replay()
+            end.record()
+            end.synchronize()
+            samples.append(start.elapsed_time(end) * 1000 / iterations)
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+    # Keep graph outputs alive until the measurement has completed.
+    del output
+    return {"median_us": statistics.median(samples), "min_us": min(samples), "max_us": max(samples)}
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--quick", action="store_true", help="Run only the three smallest shapes")
+    parser.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=7)
+    parser.add_argument("--iterations", type=int, default=100)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=529)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.repeats < 1 or args.iterations < 1:
+        parser.error("repeats and iterations must be positive")
+    if torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] != 9:
+        parser.error("this benchmark requires Hopper SM90")
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    report = {
+        "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
+        "sm_count": torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).multi_processor_count,
+        "cuda": torch.version.cuda,
+        "cutlass_dsl": cutlass.__version__,
+        "cudnn_import": cudnn.__file__,
+        "commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
+        "working_tree_dirty": bool(subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=root, text=True).strip()),
+        "timing": "FP8 attention kernel only, warmed CUDA graph replay",
+        "repeats": args.repeats,
+        "iterations": args.iterations,
+        "seed": args.seed,
+        "results": [],
+    }
+    for batch, heads, sq, sk, active_tokens in QUICK_SHAPES if args.quick else SHAPES:
+        torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
+        q = torch.randn(batch, heads, sq, HEAD_DIM, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5
+        k = torch.randn(batch, heads, sk, HEAD_DIM, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5
+        v = torch.randn_like(k) * 0.5
+        quantized = _quantize_sage_bhsd(q, k, v, v_layout="bhds")
+        row = {"shape_B_H_Sq_Sk_D": [batch, heads, sq, sk, HEAD_DIM], "active_tokens": active_tokens}
+        for block, kernel in KERNELS.items():
+            count = active_tokens // block
+            ids = torch.rand(batch, heads, sq // block, sk // block, device="cuda").argsort(-1)[..., :count].int().contiguous()
+            timing = measure(lambda: kernel(*quantized, ids, count), args.repeats, args.iterations)
+            flops = 4 * batch * heads * sq * count * block * HEAD_DIM
+            row[f"blk{block}"] = {**timing, "tflops": flops / (timing["median_us"] * 1e6)}
+        row["blk128_speedup_vs_blk64"] = row["blk64"]["median_us"] / row["blk128"]["median_us"]
+        report["results"].append(row)
+        print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
+    if args.output:
+        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

+    ascending, so a split is a KV range, and the split grid orders all Q tiles of one split before the next:

+    @cute.jit

+        clc_producer_state = cutlass_pipeline.make_pipeline_state(cutlass_pipeline.PipelineUserType.Producer, self.sched_stages)
+        work_tile = tile_scheduler.initial_work_tile_info()

+    @cute.jit

+    @cute.jit

+MASK_R2P_CHUNK_SIZE: int = 32

+MaskGenFn: TypeAlias = Callable[[int], Uint32]

+@cute.jit
+def r2p_bitmask_below(limit: Int32, s: int) -> Uint32:
+    """32-bit R2P bitmask keeping positions < limit (exclusive upper bound)."""
+    m = max((s + 1) * MASK_R2P_CHUNK_SIZE - limit, 0)
+    return utils.shr_u32(Uint32(0xFFFFFFFF), Uint32(m))

+@cute.jit
+def mask_r2p_lambda(
+    X: cute.Tensor,
+    mask_gen_fn: cutlass.Constexpr[MaskGenFn],
+) -> None:
+    """Apply R2P masking with a custom bitmask generator to a rank-1 tensor."""
+    ncol = const_expr(cute.size(X.shape))
+    CHUNK_SIZE = MASK_R2P_CHUNK_SIZE
+    for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.ceil_div(ncol, CHUNK_SIZE)):
+        mask = mask_gen_fn(s)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(min(CHUNK_SIZE, ncol - s * CHUNK_SIZE)):
+            in_bound = cutlass.Boolean(mask & (Uint32(1) << i))
+            c = s * CHUNK_SIZE + i
+            X[c] = X[c] if in_bound else -Float32.inf

+    """Reduce one K-scale group with eight maxima and three dependent levels."""
+    tValues = cute.make_rmem_tensor((16,), Float32)
+    tValues.store(values)
+    max0 = utils.fmax(tValues[0], tValues[1], tValues[2])
+    max1 = utils.fmax(tValues[3], tValues[4], tValues[5])
+    max2 = utils.fmax(tValues[6], tValues[7], tValues[8])
+    max3 = utils.fmax(tValues[9], tValues[10], tValues[11])
+    max4 = utils.fmax(tValues[12], tValues[13], tValues[14])
+    return utils.fmax(utils.fmax(max0, max1, max2), utils.fmax(max3, max4, tValues[15]))

+    """Preserve sparse semantics while computing rounded-P row sums with PV."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        head_dim: int,
+        head_dim_v: Optional[int] = None,
+        allow_empty_block_nums: bool = False,
+        has_block_sizes: bool = True,
+        block_sizes_mode: int = 1,

+        assert head_dim_v in supported_head_dims, "Sage FP8 blk128 requires value dim 128"
+
+        # padding head_dim to a multiple of 16 as k_block_size
+        hdim_multiple_of = 16
+        self.head_dim_padded = int(math.ceil(head_dim / hdim_multiple_of) * hdim_multiple_of)
+        self.head_dim_v_padded = int(math.ceil(head_dim_v / hdim_multiple_of) * hdim_multiple_of)
+        self.check_hdim_v_oob = head_dim_v != self.head_dim_v_padded
+        self.m_block_size = self.tile_m
+        self.n_block_size = self.tile_n
+        self.q_stage = 1
+        assert 1 <= num_splits <= 256
+        self.num_splits = int(num_splits)
+        self.arch = BaseDSL._get_dsl().get_arch_enum()
+        assert Arch.sm_100 <= self.arch <= Arch.sm_103f, "Sage FP8 blk128 requires SM100/SM103"
+
+        self.cta_tiler = (self.m_block_size, self.n_block_size, self.head_dim_padded)
+        self.mma_tiler_qk = (
+            self.m_block_size,
+            self.n_block_size,
+            self.head_dim_padded,
+        )
+        self.mma_tiler_pv = (
+            self.m_block_size,
+            self.head_dim_v_padded,
+            self.n_block_size,
+        )
+        self.qk_acc_dtype = Float32
+        self.pv_acc_dtype = Float32
+        # Persistent scheduling through the cluster launch control (CLC) pipeline.
+        self.sched_stages = 1
+        self.allow_empty_block_nums = allow_empty_block_nums
+        self.has_block_sizes = has_block_sizes
+        self.block_sizes_mode = block_sizes_mode
+        is_sm103 = self.arch >= Arch.sm_103 and self.arch <= Arch.sm_103f
+        self.enable_ex2_emu = self.head_dim_padded <= 128 and not is_sm103
+        self.split_P_arrive = 0
+        self.double_buffer_stats = not is_sm103
+        self.triple_buffer_p = not is_sm103
+        self.correction_tile_size = 64 if is_sm103 else 16
+        self.epilogue_tile_size = 32 if is_sm103 else 16
+        self.prefetch_all_v_scales = not is_sm103
+
+        self.softmax0_warp_ids = (0, 1, 2, 3)
+        self.softmax1_warp_ids = (4, 5, 6, 7)
+        self.correction_warp_ids = (8, 9, 10, 11)
+        self.mma_warp_id = 12
+        self.epilogue_warp_ids = (13,)
+        self.load_warp_ids = (14,)
+        self.clc_scheduler_warp_id = 15
+        self.tmem_alloc_cols = cute.arch.get_max_tmem_alloc_cols("sm_100")
+
+        self.threads_per_cta = cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(
+            (
+                *self.softmax0_warp_ids,
+                *self.softmax1_warp_ids,
+                *self.correction_warp_ids,
+                self.mma_warp_id,
+                *self.load_warp_ids,
+                *self.epilogue_warp_ids,
+                self.clc_scheduler_warp_id,
+            )
+        )
+
+        self.s_stage = 2  # Always 2: for q_stage=1 it's n-direction
+        # SM100 uses three P32 slots within the existing 512-column allocation.
+        # SM103 retains two slots; both paths keep one S128 and two O144 tiles.
+        self.tmem_s_offset = [0, 0]
+        self.tmem_o_offset = [128, 272]
+        self.tmem_p_offset = [416, 448]
+        self.p_stage = 3 if self.triple_buffer_p else 2
+        self.tmem_total = 512 if self.triple_buffer_p else 480
+        self.tmem_s_to_p_offset = 0
+        assert self.tmem_total <= self.tmem_alloc_cols
+
+        # vec buffer for row_max & row_sum
+        self.tmem_vec_offset = self.tmem_s_offset
+
+        self.num_regs_softmax = 184
+        self.num_regs_correction = 88
+        self.num_regs_other = 56
+
+        self.buffer_align_bytes = 1024
+
+    def _setup_attributes(self):
+        """Set up configurations and parameters for the FMHA kernel operation.
+
+        This method initializes and configures various attributes required for the
+        execution of the fused multi-head attention kernel, mainly about the pipeline stages:
+
+        - Sets up staging parameters for Q, K, V inputs and accumulator data
+        - Configures pipeline stages for softmax, correction, and epilogue operations
+        """
+
+        smem_size_q = self.q_stage * self.m_block_size * self.head_dim_padded * self.q_dtype.width // 8
+        smem_size_o = self.s_stage * self.m_block_size * self.head_dim_v_padded * self.o_dtype.width // 8
+        smem_size_q_o = smem_size_q + smem_size_o
+        smem_size_k_per_stage = self.n_block_size * self.head_dim_padded * self.k_dtype.width // 8
+        smem_size_v_per_stage = self.n_block_size * self.head_dim_v_padded * self.v_dtype.width // 8
+        smem_size_kv_per_stage = max(smem_size_k_per_stage, smem_size_v_per_stage)
+        self.kv_stage = (224 * 1024 - smem_size_q_o - 16384) // smem_size_kv_per_stage
+        # self.s_stage is defined in __init__ (always 2)
+        assert self.s_stage >= self.q_stage

+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        mQ: cute.Tensor,  # (b, h, s_q, d)
+        mK: cute.Tensor,  # (b, h, s_k, d)
+        mV: cute.Tensor,  # (b, h, s_k, dv)
+        mO: cute.Tensor,  # (b, h, s_q, dv)
+        mLSE: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mQScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mVScale: cute.Tensor,
+        softmax_scale: Float32,
+        mBlockIndex: cute.Tensor,  # (batch, heads, num_q_blocks, max_kv_blocks), int32
+        mBlockSizes: cute.Tensor,  # (num_kv_blocks,), int32
+        block_sparse_num: Int32,  # runtime scalar >= 1; odd counts use a masked phantom block
+        mBlockNums: Optional[cute.Tensor],  # (batch, heads, num_q_blocks), int32 or None
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """Execute the Fused Multi-Head Attention operation on the provided tensors.
+
+        This method prepares the input tensors for processing, validates their shapes and types,
+        configures the computation parameters, and launches the CUDA kernel.
+
+        The method handles:
+        1. Tensor layout transformations for specific memory access patterns
+        2. Validation of tensor shapes and data types
+        3. Initialization of hardware-specific parameters and memory layouts
+        4. Configuration of TMA (Tensor Memory Access) operations
+        5. Grid and work scheduling computation
+        6. Kernel launch with appropriate parameters
+        """
+        assert (mLSE is not None) == (self.num_splits > 1), "Split producers require LSE"
+        # setup static attributes before smem/grid/tma computation
+        self.q_dtype = mQ.element_type
+        self.k_dtype = mK.element_type
+        self.v_dtype = mV.element_type
+        self.o_dtype = mO.element_type
+        assert self.q_dtype == cutlass.Float8E4M3FN
+        assert self.o_dtype == (Float32 if self.num_splits > 1 else cutlass.BFloat16)
+        mQ, mK, mV, mO = [assume_tensor_aligned(t) for t in (mQ, mK, mV, mO)]
+        # Kernel boundary contract is BHSD. Convert (B, H, S, D) to
+        # the mainloop/TMA-friendly (S, D, H, B) view internally.
+        Q_layout_transpose = [2, 3, 1, 0]
+        mQ = cute.make_tensor(mQ.iterator, cute.select(mQ.layout, mode=Q_layout_transpose))
+        # (s_k, d, h_k, b_k)
+        KV_layout_transpose = [2, 3, 1, 0]
+        mK, mV = [cute.make_tensor(t.iterator, cute.select(t.layout, mode=KV_layout_transpose)) for t in (mK, mV)]
+        O_layout_transpose = [2, 3, 1, 0]
+        LSE_layout_transpose = [2, 1, 0]
+        num_splits = Int32(self.num_splits)
+        mO = cute.make_tensor(mO.iterator, cute.select(mO.layout, mode=O_layout_transpose))
+        mLSE = cute.make_tensor(mLSE.iterator, cute.select(mLSE.layout, mode=LSE_layout_transpose)) if const_expr(mLSE is not None) else None
+        # (s, d, h, b) -> (d, s, h, b)
+        V_layout_transpose = [1, 0, 2, 3]
+        mV = cute.make_tensor(mV.iterator, cute.select(mV.layout, mode=V_layout_transpose))
+
+        # check type consistency
+        if const_expr(self.q_dtype != self.k_dtype):
+            raise TypeError(f"Type mismatch: {self.q_dtype} != {self.k_dtype}")
+        if const_expr(self.q_dtype != self.v_dtype):
+            raise TypeError(f"Type mismatch: {self.q_dtype} != {self.v_dtype}")
+        self._setup_attributes()
+        q_major_mode = OperandMajorMode.K
+        k_major_mode = OperandMajorMode.K
+        v_major_mode = OperandMajorMode.MN
+        self.o_layout = LayoutEnum.from_tensor(mO)

+        p_source = tcgen05.OperandSource.TMEM
+        p_major_mode = OperandMajorMode.K
+        tiled_mma_qk = sm100_utils_basic.make_trivial_tiled_mma(
+            self.q_dtype,
+            self.k_dtype,
+            q_major_mode,
+            k_major_mode,
+            self.qk_acc_dtype,
+            tcgen05.CtaGroup.ONE,
+            self.mma_tiler_qk[:2],
+        )
+        tiled_mma_pv = sm100_utils_basic.make_trivial_tiled_mma(
+            self.q_dtype,
+            self.v_dtype,
+            p_major_mode,
+            v_major_mode,
+            self.pv_acc_dtype,
+            tcgen05.CtaGroup.ONE,
+            self.mma_tiler_pv[:2],
+            p_source,
+        )
+
+        self.epi_tile = (self.m_block_size, self.head_dim_v_padded)
+
+        sQ_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_a(tiled_mma_qk, self.mma_tiler_qk, self.q_dtype, self.q_stage)
+        sK_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_b(tiled_mma_qk, self.mma_tiler_qk, self.k_dtype, self.kv_stage)
+        tP_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_a(tiled_mma_pv, self.mma_tiler_pv, self.q_dtype, self.s_stage)
+        sV_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_b(tiled_mma_pv, self.mma_tiler_pv, self.v_dtype, self.kv_stage)
+        sO_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_epi(self.o_dtype, self.o_layout, self.epi_tile, self.s_stage)
+        self.tma_copy_bytes = {
+            name: cute.size_in_bytes(mX.element_type, cute.select(layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]))
+            for name, mX, layout in [

+                ("K", mK, sK_layout),
+                ("V", mV, sV_layout),

+        }
+        # TMA load for Q

+            tma_load_op,
+            mQ,
+            cute.select(sQ_layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]),
+            self.mma_tiler_qk,
+            tiled_mma_qk,

+

+            tma_load_op,
+            mK,
+            cute.select(sK_layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]),
+            self.mma_tiler_qk,
+            tiled_mma_qk,

+            mV,
+            cute.select(sV_layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]),
+            self.mma_tiler_pv,
+            tiled_mma_pv,

+        tma_atom_O, mO = cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(tma_store_op, mO, cute.select(sO_layout, mode=[0, 1]), self.epi_tile)
+
+        tile_sched_args = TileSchedulerArguments(
+            cute.ceil_div(cute.size(mQ.shape[0]), self.cta_tiler[0]),
+            cute.size(mQ.shape[2]),
+            cute.size(mQ.shape[3]),
+            num_splits,
+            cute.size(mK.shape[0]),
+            mQ.shape[1],
+            mV.shape[0],  # Note that this is different from Sm90 since we transpose mV in Sm100

+        self.tile_scheduler_cls = TileScheduler

+        sO_size = cute.cosize(sO_layout)

+            mbar_load_KV: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.kv_stage * 2]
+            mbar_S_full_P_full_O_rescaled: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            mbar_P_ready: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.p_stage * 2]
+            mbar_O_full: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            mbar_softmax_stats: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            mbar_O_epi: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]

+            tmem_holding_buf: Int32
+            # Smem tensors
+            # store row max and row sum
+            sScale: cute.struct.MemRange[Float32, self.s_stage * self.m_block_size * 2]
+            # Keep independent 32-byte stages aligned for vectorized shared loads.

+            sO: cute.struct.Align[cute.struct.MemRange[self.o_dtype, sO_size], self.buffer_align_bytes]

+            sK: cute.struct.Align[

+                self.buffer_align_bytes,

+            sOnes: cute.struct.Align[cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, 4096], 1024]

+        softmax_scale_log2, softmax_scale = utils.compute_softmax_scale_log2(softmax_scale)
+
+        # Launch the kernel synchronously
+        self.kernel(
+            mQ,
+            mK,
+            mV,
+            mO,
+            mLSE,
+            mQScale,
+            mKScale,
+            mVScale,
+            tma_atom_Q,
+            tma_atom_K,
+            tma_atom_V,
+            tma_atom_O,
+            softmax_scale_log2,
+            softmax_scale,
+            sQ_layout,
+            sK_layout,
+            tP_layout,
+            sV_layout,
+            sO_layout,
+            tiled_mma_qk,

+            block=[self.threads_per_cta, 1, 1],

+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        mQ: cute.Tensor,  # (s_q, d, h, b)
+        mK: cute.Tensor,  # (s_k, d, h_k, b_k)
+        mV: cute.Tensor,  # (d, s_k, h_k, b_k)
+        mO: cute.Tensor,
+        mLSE: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mQScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mVScale: cute.Tensor,
+        tma_atom_Q: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_K: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_V: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_O: cute.CopyAtom,
+        softmax_scale_log2: Float32,
+        softmax_scale: Float32 | None,
+        sQ_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sK_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        tP_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sV_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sO_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        tiled_mma_qk: cute.TiledMma,
+        tiled_mma_pv: cute.TiledMma,
+        tile_sched_params: ParamsBase,
+        mBlockIndex: cute.Tensor,
+        mBlockSizes: cute.Tensor,
+        block_sparse_num: Int32,
+        mBlockNums: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    ):
+        """The device kernel implementation of the Fused Multi-Head Attention.
+
+        This kernel coordinates multiple specialized warps to perform different phases of the FMHA computation:
+        1. Load warp: Loads Q, K, V data from global memory to shared memory using TMA
+        2. MMA warp: Performs matrix multiplications (Q*K^T and P*V)
+        3. Softmax warps: Compute softmax normalization on attention scores
+        4. Correction warps: Apply adjustments to intermediate results
+        5. Epilogue warp: Handles final output transformation and storage
+
+        The kernel implements a complex pipeline with overlapping computation and memory operations,
+        using tensor memory access (TMA) for efficient data loading, warp specialization for different
+        computation phases, and optional attention masking.
+        """
+
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx())
+
+        # Prefetch tma descriptor
+        if warp_idx == 0:
+            for tma_atom in (tma_atom_Q, tma_atom_K, tma_atom_V, tma_atom_O):
+                cpasync.prefetch_descriptor(tma_atom)
+
+        # Alloc
+        smem = SmemAllocator()
+        storage = smem.allocate(self.shared_storage)
+        sOnesPtr = storage.sOnes.data_ptr()
+        sOnes = storage.sOnes.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(4096))
+        thread = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            sOnes[thread + i * self.threads_per_cta] = Int32(0x38383838)
+        cute.arch.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+
+        tmem_alloc_barrier = _SubsetNamedBarrier(
+            barrier_id=int(NamedBarrierFwdSm100.TmemPtr),
+            num_threads=cute.arch.WARP_SIZE
+            * len(
+                (
+                    self.mma_warp_id,
+                    *self.softmax0_warp_ids,
+                    *self.softmax1_warp_ids,
+                    *self.correction_warp_ids,
+                )
+            ),
+        )
+        # Tensor memory dealloc barrier init
+        tmem = TmemAllocator(
+            storage.tmem_holding_buf.ptr,
+            barrier_for_retrieve=tmem_alloc_barrier,
+            allocator_warp_id=self.mma_warp_id,
+        )
+
+        ThreadCooperativeGroup = partial(pipeline.CooperativeGroup, pipeline.Agent.Thread)
+        mma_warp = ThreadCooperativeGroup(len([self.mma_warp_id]))
+        tma_warp = ThreadCooperativeGroup(1)
+        softmax_warps = ThreadCooperativeGroup(len(self.softmax0_warp_ids))
+        softmax_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.softmax0_warp_ids))
+        correction_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.correction_warp_ids))
+        softmax_correction_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.softmax0_warp_ids + self.correction_warp_ids))
+        epilogue_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.epilogue_warp_ids))
+        pipeline_q = pipeline_custom.PipelineTmaUmma.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_load_Q.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.q_stage,
+            producer_group=tma_warp,
+            consumer_group=mma_warp,
+            tx_count=self.tma_copy_bytes["Q"],
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        pipeline_kv = pipeline_custom.PipelineTmaUmma.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_load_KV.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.kv_stage,
+            producer_group=tma_warp,
+            consumer_group=mma_warp,
+            tx_count=self.tma_copy_bytes["K"],
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        # This pipeline is not the typical producer-consumer pipeline. The "producer" mma warp
+        # uses it to signal that S is ready, and the softmax threads wait for S to be ready.
+        # When softmax threads write P to tmem and the correction threads have rescaled O, they
+        # signal as "consumer". SM100 separates P-ready from correction-only O credits.
+        pipeline_s_p_o = pipeline_custom.PipelineUmmaAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_S_full_P_full_O_rescaled.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,
+            producer_group=mma_warp,
+            consumer_group=(correction_threads if self.triple_buffer_p else softmax_correction_threads),
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        if const_expr(self.triple_buffer_p):
+            pipeline_p_ready = pipeline_custom.PipelineAsync.create(
+                barrier_storage=storage.mbar_P_ready.data_ptr(),
+                num_stages=self.p_stage,
+                producer_group=softmax_threads,
+                consumer_group=mma_warp,
+                defer_sync=True,
+            )
+        else:
+            pipeline_p_ready = pipeline_custom.PipelineAsyncUmma.create(
+                barrier_storage=storage.mbar_P_ready.data_ptr(),
+                num_stages=self.s_stage,
+                producer_group=softmax_warps,
+                consumer_group=mma_warp,
+                defer_sync=True,
+            )
+        # MMA warp uses this to signal to the correction warps that O is ready.
+        pipeline_o_acc = pipeline_custom.PipelineUmmaAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_O_full.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,

+            q_smem_start[self.q_stage - 1],
+            q_smem_base,
+            tSrQ[None, None, None, 0].layout,
+            var_name_prefix="bsa_fwd_q_smem_desc",

+                    if const_expr(self.triple_buffer_p):
+                        p_slot = p_read_counter
+                        p_phase = Int32(0)
+                        if p_slot >= 3:
+                            p_slot -= 3
+                            p_phase = Int32(1)
+                        pipeline_p_ready.consumer_wait_w_index_phase(p_slot, p_phase)
+                        fp8_helpers.tcgen05_fence_after_thread_sync()
+                        gemm_Pi[epi_stage_constexpr](
+                            tmem_probability=Int32(416) + p_slot * 32,
+                            tCrB=tOrVi,
+                            sB=sV_cur,
+                            zero_init=epi_zi,
+                            mbar_ptr=(pipeline_p_ready.sync_object_full.get_barrier(epi_s) if self.split_P_arrive > 0 else None),
+                            mbar_phase=epi_p,
+                        )
+                    else:
+                        gemm_Pi[epi_stage_constexpr](
+                            tCrB=tOrVi,
+                            sB=sV_cur,
+                            zero_init=epi_zi,
+                            mbar_ptr=(pipeline_p_ready.sync_object_full.get_barrier(epi_s) if self.split_P_arrive > 0 else None),
+                            mbar_phase=epi_p,
+                        )
+                    pipeline_o_acc.producer_commit_w_index(epi_s)
+                    if const_expr(self.triple_buffer_p):
+                        p_read_counter += 1
+                        if p_read_counter >= 6:
+                            p_read_counter -= 6
+                    pipeline_kv.consumer_release(mma_kv_consumer_state)
+                    mma_kv_consumer_state.advance()
+                # Epilogue did one acquire per stage; advance phases for next tile
+                phase_s0 ^= 1
+                phase_s1 ^= 1
+
+            # Advance to next tile
+            work_tile = tile_scheduler.consumer_advance()

+    @cute.jit
+    def softmax_loop(
+        self,
+        stage: int | Int32,
+        softmax_scale_log2: Float32,
+        softmax_scale: Float32,
+        sScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mLSE: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        pipeline_s_p_o: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_p_ready: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_o_acc: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_sm_stats: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        sm_stats_barrier: pipeline.NamedBarrier,
+        block_info: "BlockInfo",
+        tile_scheduler: "TileSchedulerProtocol",
+        mBlockIndex: cute.Tensor,
+        mBlockSizes: cute.Tensor,
+        block_sparse_num: Int32,
+        mBlockNums: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mQScale: cute.Tensor,
+        sKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        seqlen_q: Int32,
+        seqlen_k: Int32,
+    ):
+        """Compute softmax on attention scores from QK matrix multiplication.
+
+        This method handles the softmax computation for either the first or second half of the
+        attention matrix, depending on the 'stage' parameter. It calculates row-wise maximum
+        and sum values needed for stable softmax computation, applies optional masking, and
+        transforms raw attention scores into probability distributions.
+
+        The implementation uses specialized memory access patterns and efficient math operations
+        for computing exp(x) using exp2 functions. It also coordinates pipeline
+        synchronization between MMA, correction, and sequence processing stages.
+        """
+        tidx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % (cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * (len(self.softmax0_warp_ids)))
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx()) % 4
+
+        mma_si_consumer_phase = Int32(0)
+        sm_stats_producer_phase = Int32(1)
+        p_write_counter = Int32(stage)
+
+        work_tile = tile_scheduler.initial_work_tile_info()
+        while work_tile.is_valid_tile:
+            m_block, head_idx, batch_idx, split_idx = work_tile.tile_idx
+
+            # n_block(i): maps logical index i to actual KV block index via q2k_block_index
+            if const_expr(self.num_splits > 1):
+                split_begin, raw_block_count = self._split_block_range(mBlockNums, block_sparse_num, batch_idx, head_idx, m_block, split_idx)
+                has_work = raw_block_count > Int32(0)
+                mBlockIndex_split = cute.make_tensor(mBlockIndex.iterator + split_begin, mBlockIndex.layout)
+                n_block = partial(
+                    block_info.get_n_block_idx,
+                    mBlockIndex_split,
+                    batch_idx,
+                    head_idx,
+                    m_block,
+                    max_i=cutlass.max(raw_block_count - 1, Int32(0)),
+                )
+            elif const_expr(mBlockNums is not None):
+                raw_block_count = mBlockNums[batch_idx, head_idx, m_block]
+                has_work = raw_block_count > Int32(0) if const_expr(self.allow_empty_block_nums) else True
+                n_block = partial(
+                    block_info.get_n_block_idx,
+                    mBlockIndex,
+                    batch_idx,
+                    head_idx,
+                    m_block,
+                    max_i=cutlass.max(raw_block_count - 1, Int32(0)),
+                )
+            else:
+                raw_block_count = block_sparse_num
+                has_work = True
+                n_block = partial(
+                    block_info.get_n_block_idx,
+                    mBlockIndex,
+                    batch_idx,
+                    head_idx,
+                    m_block,
+                    max_i=cutlass.max(block_sparse_num - 1, Int32(0)),
+                )
+
+            softmax = SoftmaxSm100.create(
+                Float32(1.0),
+                rescale_threshold=math.log2(448.0 / 128.0),
+                softmax_scale=None,
+            )
+            softmax.reset()
+
+            softmax_step = partial(
+                self.softmax_step,
+                softmax=softmax,
+                pipeline_s_p_o=pipeline_s_p_o,
+                pipeline_p_ready=pipeline_p_ready,
+                pipeline_o_acc=pipeline_o_acc,
+                pipeline_sm_stats=pipeline_sm_stats,
+                sm_stats_barrier=sm_stats_barrier,
+                sScale=sScale,
+                stage=stage,
+                q_log2_scale=mQScale[batch_idx, head_idx, cutlass.min(m_block * 128 + tidx, seqlen_q - 1)] * softmax_scale_log2,
+                sKScale=sKScale,
+                tmem_s_addr=Int32(warp_idx * 32 << 16),
+                tmem_p_addr=self.tmem_p_offset[0] + stage * (self.tmem_p_offset[1] - self.tmem_p_offset[0]) + (warp_idx * 32 << 16),
+            )
+
+            # Always acquire pipeline_sm_stats to stay in sync with correction
+            pipeline_sm_stats.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(stage, sm_stats_producer_phase)
+            sm_stats_producer_phase ^= 1
+
+            if has_work:
+                # block_iter_count is even: each WG processes exactly half the blocks
+                # WG0 (stage=0): logical indices N-1, N-3, ... (stride 2)
+                # WG1 (stage=1): logical indices N-2, N-4, ... (stride 2)
+                if const_expr(mBlockNums is not None or self.num_splits > 1):
+                    block_iter_count = (raw_block_count + 1) & ~1
+                else:
+                    block_iter_count = (block_sparse_num + 1) & ~1
+                wg_count = block_iter_count // 2
+                # logical_first is the first logical index for this WG
+                logical_first = block_iter_count - 1 - stage
+
+                # 1st block — phantom block (logical_first >= raw_block_count) uses block_size=0
+                n_block_first = n_block(logical_first)
+                first_block_size = self.valid_block_size(mBlockSizes, batch_idx, head_idx, n_block_first, seqlen_k)
+                if logical_first >= raw_block_count:
+                    first_block_size = Int32(0)
+                first_mask_fn = partial(apply_block_size_mask, block_size=first_block_size, n_block_size=128)
+                mma_si_consumer_phase, sm_stats_producer_phase, p_write_counter = softmax_step(
+                    mma_si_consumer_phase,
+                    sm_stats_producer_phase,
+                    p_write_counter,
+                    valid_tokens=first_block_size,
+                    mask_fn=first_mask_fn,
+                    is_first=True,
+                )
+                # Remaining blocks with stride 2 — always valid (logical_n < raw_block_count)
+                for n_tile in cutlass.range(wg_count - 1, unroll=1):
+                    logical_n = logical_first - self.s_stage * (n_tile + 1)
+                    n_block_cur = n_block(logical_n)
+                    remaining_mask_fn = partial(
+                        apply_block_size_mask,
+                        block_size=self.valid_block_size(mBlockSizes, batch_idx, head_idx, n_block_cur, seqlen_k),
+                        n_block_size=128,
+                    )
+                    mma_si_consumer_phase, sm_stats_producer_phase, p_write_counter = softmax_step(
+                        mma_si_consumer_phase,
+                        sm_stats_producer_phase,
+                        p_write_counter,
+                        valid_tokens=self.valid_block_size(mBlockSizes, batch_idx, head_idx, n_block_cur, seqlen_k),
+                        mask_fn=remaining_mask_fn,
+                    )
+
+                if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    # Drain the last scale readers before reusing both slots for
+                    # the final payload. Terminal and steady ready IDs are distinct.
+                    _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=11, num_threads=256).arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=stage * 2)
+                else:
+                    # Final statistics have no next-QK ownership edge. Wait for
+                    # the last scale reader before reusing its shared slot.
+                    pipeline_sm_stats.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(stage, sm_stats_producer_phase)
+                    sm_stats_producer_phase ^= 1
+                sScale[tidx + stage * self.m_block_size] = softmax.row_sum[0]
+                if const_expr(mLSE is not None or self.q_stage == 1):
+                    sScale[tidx + stage * self.m_block_size + self.s_stage * self.m_block_size] = softmax.row_max[0]
+                if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=11, num_threads=256).arrive_w_index(index=stage * 2)
+                else:
+                    sm_stats_barrier.arrive_w_index(index=stage * 4 + warp_idx)
+            else:
+                # Empty tiles publish only their terminal notification.
+                if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=11, num_threads=256).arrive_w_index(index=stage * 2)
+                else:
+                    sm_stats_barrier.arrive_w_index(index=stage * 4 + warp_idx)
+
+            # Advance to next tile
+            work_tile = tile_scheduler.consumer_advance()
+        # End of persistent scheduler loop
+
+        # This is equivalent to pipeline_sm_stats.producer_tail
+        pipeline_sm_stats.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(stage, sm_stats_producer_phase)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def softmax_step(
+        self,
+        mma_si_consumer_phase: Int32,
+        sm_stats_producer_phase: Int32,
+        p_write_counter: Int32,
+        softmax: "SoftmaxSm100",
+        pipeline_s_p_o: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_p_ready: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_o_acc: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_sm_stats: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        sm_stats_barrier: pipeline.NamedBarrier,
+        sScale: cute.Tensor,
+        stage: int | Int32,
+        q_log2_scale: Float32,
+        sKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        tmem_s_addr: Int32,
+        tmem_p_addr: Int32,
+        valid_tokens: Int32,
+        mask_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,
+        is_first: bool = False,
+    ) -> Tuple[cute.Int32, cute.Int32, cute.Int32]:
+        """Perform a single step of the softmax computation on a block of attention scores.
+
+        This method processes one block of the attention matrix, computing numerically stable
+        softmax by first finding the row maximum, subtracting it from all elements, applying
+        exponential function, and then normalizing by the sum of exponentials. It also handles
+        optional masking of attention scores.
+
+        The method involves several key operations:
+        1. Loading attention scores from tensor memory
+        2. Applying optional masking based on position
+        3. Computing row-wise maximum values for numerical stability
+        4. Transforming scores using exp2(x*scale - max*scale)
+        5. Computing row sums for normalization
+        6. Coordinating pipeline synchronization between different processing stages
+        """
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx()) % 4
+        if const_expr(self.triple_buffer_p):
+            p_slot = p_write_counter
+            if p_slot >= 3:
+                p_slot -= 3
+            tmem_p_addr = Int32(416) + p_slot * 32 + (warp_idx * 32 << 16)
+        # S_i completion covers the previous owner of P[i % 3].
+        pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_wait_w_index_phase(stage, mma_si_consumer_phase)
+        tSrS_t2r = cute.make_rmem_tensor((128,), Float32)
+        qk_scales = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), Float32)
+        group_maxima = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), Float32)
+        for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            qk_scales[group] = q_log2_scale * sKScale[(mma_si_consumer_phase * 2 + stage) * 8 + group]
+        if const_expr(self.arch >= Arch.sm_103 and self.arch <= Arch.sm_103f):
+            for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                vals, group_max = tmem_load_red_max_32dp32b16x(tmem_s_addr + group * 16)
+                group_maxima[group] = group_max
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+                    tSrS_t2r[group * 16 + j] = vals[j]
+        else:
+            for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                vals = fp8_helpers.tmem_load_32dp32b32x(tmem_s_addr + group * 32)
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(32):
+                    tSrS_t2r[group * 32 + j] = vals[j]
+        # Retire every raw S load before another QK may overwrite its tile.
+        cute.arch.fence_view_async_tmem_load()
+        fp8_helpers.tcgen05_fence_before_thread_sync()
+        _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=12, num_threads=160).arrive_w_index(index=0)
+        if const_expr(mask_fn is not None):
+            mask_fn(tSrS_t2r)
+        tSrS_groups = cute.logical_divide(tSrS_t2r, cute.make_layout(16))
+        if const_expr(self.arch >= Arch.sm_103 and self.arch <= Arch.sm_103f):
+            if valid_tokens < 128:
+                for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    group_maxima[group] = _max16_tree(tSrS_groups[None, group].load())
+        else:
+            for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                group_maxima[group] = _max16_tree(tSrS_groups[None, group].load())
+        for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            group_maxima[group] *= qk_scales[group]
+        row_max, acc_scale = softmax.update_row_max(group_maxima.load(), is_first)
+
+        if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+            # Correction reconstructs alpha from consecutive selected maxima.
+            # Keep the P bias in registers while publishing its shared payload.
+            thread_idx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % self.m_block_size
+            scale_index = thread_idx + (mma_si_consumer_phase * 2 + stage) * self.m_block_size
+            selected_max = _publish_row_max(
+                Int32((sScale.iterator + scale_index).toint()),
+                softmax.row_max[0],
+                Int32(3 + stage * 2 + mma_si_consumer_phase),
+            )
+            row_max = selected_max if selected_max != -Float32.inf else Float32(0.0)
+        else:
+            if const_expr(not is_first):
+                # Delay this wait until the next score load/reduction has finished.
+                # Correction can consume the previous scale while that work runs.
+                pipeline_sm_stats.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(stage, sm_stats_producer_phase)
+                sm_stats_producer_phase ^= 1
+                thread_idx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % self.m_block_size
+                sScale[thread_idx + stage * self.m_block_size] = acc_scale
+            # Publish scale ownership for every block, including the first.
+            sm_stats_barrier.arrive_w_index(index=stage * 4 + warp_idx)
+
+        # Fold input dequantization, attention scale and P*128 into one FMA.
+        # Store rounded P in 32-token chunks. The widened PV accumulates
+        # the same rounded probabilities into its appended denominator.
+        bias = Float32(7.0) - row_max
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            p_frag = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), Int32)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(0, 32, 4):
+                offset = i * 32 + j
+                score_scale = qk_scales[offset // 16]
+                x0, x1 = cute.arch.fma_packed_f32x2(
+                    (tSrS_t2r[offset], tSrS_t2r[offset + 1]),
+                    (score_scale, score_scale),
+                    (bias, bias),
+                )
+                x2, x3 = cute.arch.fma_packed_f32x2(
+                    (tSrS_t2r[offset + 2], tSrS_t2r[offset + 3]),
+                    (score_scale, score_scale),
+                    (bias, bias),
+                )
+                e0, e1 = cute.math.exp2(x0, fastmath=True), cute.math.exp2(x1, fastmath=True)
+                if const_expr(self.enable_ex2_emu and i < 3 and j % 12 < 8):
+                    e2, e3 = utils.ex2_emulation_2(x2, x3)
+                else:
+                    e2, e3 = cute.math.exp2(x2, fastmath=True), cute.math.exp2(x3, fastmath=True)
+                p_frag[j // 4] = fp8_helpers.cvt_f32x4_to_e4m3x4(e0, e1, e2, e3)
+            # The third P slot is free at S readiness on SM100. SM103
+            # retains its previous-PV ownership wait before reusing P.
+            if const_expr(not self.triple_buffer_p and not is_first and i == 0):
+                pipeline_o_acc.consumer_wait_w_index_phase(stage, mma_si_consumer_phase ^ 1)
+            fp8_helpers.tmem_store_e4m3x8(tmem_p_addr + i * 8, p_frag)
+            if const_expr(i + 1 == self.split_P_arrive // 32):
+                cute.arch.fence_view_async_tmem_store()
+                fp8_helpers.tcgen05_fence_before_thread_sync()
+                pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+        cute.arch.fence_view_async_tmem_store()
+        fp8_helpers.tcgen05_fence_before_thread_sync()
+        if const_expr(self.triple_buffer_p):
+            pipeline_p_ready.producer_commit_w_index(p_slot)
+            p_write_counter += 2
+            if p_write_counter >= 6:
+                p_write_counter -= 6
+        else:
+            if const_expr(self.split_P_arrive > 0):
+                cute.arch.sync_warp()
+                with cute.arch.elect_one():
+                    pipeline_p_ready.producer_commit_w_index(stage)
+            else:
+                # The single P credit now orders every probability store before PV.
+                pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+        return mma_si_consumer_phase ^ 1, sm_stats_producer_phase, p_write_counter
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def correction_loop(
+        self,
+        thr_mma_pv: cute.ThrMma,
+        tOtO: cute.Tensor,
+        sScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mLSE: cute.Tensor,
+        sO: cute.Tensor,
+        pipeline_s_p_o: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_o_acc: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_sm_stats: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        sm_stats_barrier: pipeline.NamedBarrier,
+        pipeline_o_epi: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        softmax_scale_log2: Float32,
+        SeqlenInfoCls: Callable,
+        tile_scheduler: "TileSchedulerProtocol",
+        block_sparse_num: Int32,
+        mBlockNums: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mVScale: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        tidx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % (cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.correction_warp_ids))
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx()) % 4
+
+        # SM100 protects the first selected-max reader with its initial O credit.
+        # SM103 retains the scale-payload protocol and initial credits.
+        if const_expr(not self.double_buffer_stats):
+            for stage in cutlass.range(self.s_stage):
+                pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+
+        sm_stats_consumer_phase = Int32(0)
+        o_corr_consumer_phase = Int32(0)
+        corr_epi_producer_phase = Int32(1)
+
+        work_tile = tile_scheduler.initial_work_tile_info()
+        while work_tile.is_valid_tile:
+            m_block, head_idx, batch_idx, split_idx = work_tile.tile_idx
+            seqlen = SeqlenInfoCls()
+
+            # For q_stage=1, always need row_max for combine; use -inf as default
+            stats = [
+                (
+                    Float32(0.0),
+                    -Float32.inf if const_expr(mLSE is not None or self.q_stage == 1) else None,
+                    True,
+                )
+            ] * self.s_stage
+
+            if const_expr(self.num_splits > 1):
+                _, split_block_count = self._split_block_range(mBlockNums, block_sparse_num, batch_idx, head_idx, m_block, split_idx)
+                has_work = split_block_count > Int32(0)
+            elif const_expr(mBlockNums is not None):
+                has_work = mBlockNums[batch_idx, head_idx, m_block] > Int32(0) if const_expr(self.allow_empty_block_nums) else True
+            else:
+                has_work = True
+
+            if has_work:
+                if const_expr(not self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    # The first dummy credit starts explicit scale ownership.
+                    sm_stats_barrier.arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=0 * 4 + warp_idx)
+                    pipeline_sm_stats.consumer_release_w_index(0)
+                    sm_stats_barrier.arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=1 * 4 + warp_idx)
+                    pipeline_sm_stats.consumer_release_w_index(1)
+                    sm_stats_consumer_phase ^= 1
+
+                if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    previous_row_max = cute.make_rmem_tensor((2,), Float32)

+def quantize_sage_bhsd(*args):
+    from cudnn.block_sparse_attention._fp8_quant import _quantize_sage_bhsd
+
+    return _quantize_sage_bhsd(*args)

+def bsa_fp8_fwd(q, k, v, qs, ks, vs, index, topk, scale=None, *, sparse_block_size=128, block_sizes=None, q2k_block_nums=None, kv_splits=1):
+    from cudnn.block_sparse_attention._interface import _bsa_attn_fwd_sm100_fp8_blk128
+
+    assert sparse_block_size == 128
+    return _bsa_attn_fwd_sm100_fp8_blk128(q, k, v, qs, ks, vs, index, topk, scale, block_sizes, q2k_block_nums, kv_splits)
+

+def make_inputs(batch, heads, sq, sk, *, gain=1.0):
+    return tuple((torch.randn(batch, heads, seq, 128, device="cuda") * gain).bfloat16() for seq in (sq, sk, sk))
+
+
+def make_metadata(batch, heads, sq, sk, topk, *, variable=False, sizes_mode=0):
+    """Unsorted, distinct sparse indices; inactive slots deliberately invalid."""
+    nq, nk = math.ceil(sq / 128), math.ceil(sk / 128)
+    index = torch.stack([torch.randperm(nk)[:topk] for _ in range(batch * heads * nq)]).reshape(batch, heads, nq, topk).to(device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    nums = None
+    if variable:
+        nums = (torch.arange(batch * heads * nq) % (topk + 1)).reshape(batch, heads, nq)
+        nums = nums.to(device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+        inactive = torch.arange(topk, device="cuda") >= nums[..., None]
+        index.masked_fill_(inactive, 0x3FFFFFFF)
+    sizes = None
+    if sizes_mode:
+        shape = {1: (nk,), 2: (batch, nk), 3: (batch, heads, nk)}[sizes_mode]
+        sizes = torch.randint(1, 129, shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+        sizes[..., -1].clamp_(max=sk - (nk - 1) * 128)
+    return index, nums, sizes
+
+
+def sparse_reference(q, k, v, index, topk, nums=None, sizes=None, scale=None):
+    """FP32 torch matmul/softmax over exactly the selected valid KV tokens."""
+    batch, heads, sq, dim = q.shape
+    sk = k.shape[2]
+    scale = dim**-0.5 if scale is None else scale
+    out = torch.empty_like(q, dtype=torch.float32)
+    offsets = torch.arange(128, device=q.device)
+    for qb in range(index.shape[2]):
+        blocks = index[:, :, qb].long()
+        count = topk if nums is None else nums[:, :, qb, None]
+        live = torch.arange(blocks.shape[-1], device=q.device) < count
+        # Empty and unused slots must never address the underlying tensors.
+        blocks = blocks.masked_fill(~live, 0)
+        tokens = blocks[..., None] * 128 + offsets
+        valid = live[..., None] & (tokens < sk)
+        if sizes is not None:
+            if sizes.ndim == 1:
+                extent = sizes[blocks]
+            elif sizes.ndim == 2:
+                extent = sizes[torch.arange(batch, device=q.device)[:, None, None], blocks]
+            else:
+                extent = sizes.gather(2, blocks)
+            valid = valid & (offsets < extent[..., None])
+        tokens = tokens.clamp(0, sk - 1).flatten(-2)
+        gather = tokens[..., None].expand(-1, -1, -1, dim)
+        kt = k.gather(2, gather).float()
+        vt = v.gather(2, gather).float()
+        begin, end = qb * 128, min((qb + 1) * 128, sq)
+        scores = (q[:, :, begin:end].float() @ kt.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+        scores.masked_fill_(~valid.flatten(-2).unsqueeze(-2), -torch.inf)
+        probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).nan_to_num()
+        out[:, :, begin:end] = probs @ vt
+    return out
+
+
+def dequantize(quantized):
+    q, k, v, qs, ks, vs = quantized
+    batch, heads, sq, dim = q.shape
+    sk = k.shape[2]
+    return (
+        (q.float() * qs.reshape(batch, heads, sq, 1)).bfloat16(),
+        (k.float() * ks.reshape(batch, heads, -1).repeat_interleave(16, dim=-1)[..., :sk, None]).bfloat16(),
+        (v.float() * vs.reshape(1, heads, 1, dim)).bfloat16(),
+    )
+
+
+def assert_accuracy(out, ref, *, relative=0.029, absolute=0.15):
+    assert out.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert torch.isfinite(out).all()
+    error = (out.float() - ref.float()).abs()
+    rel = (error.mean() / ref.abs().mean().clamp_min(1e-8)).item()
+    maximum = error.max().item()
+    assert maximum < absolute, f"max absolute error {maximum} >= {absolute}"
+    assert rel < relative, f"mean relative error {rel} >= {relative}"
+    return rel, maximum

+        view = storage[..., 0]
+        views.append(view.reshape(-1) if flatten else view)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    try:
+        stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            actual = attention(views)
+            with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream):
+                captured = attention(views)
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+        graph.replay()
+        assert torch.equal(actual, expected)

+def _inputs(batch=1, heads=1, sq=64, sk=192):
+    torch.manual_seed(529)
+    q = torch.randn((batch, heads, sq, 128), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5
+    k = torch.randn((batch, heads, sk, 128), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5
+    return q, k, torch.randn_like(k) * 0.5
+
+
+def _ids(batch, heads, sq, sk, block=64):
+    """Every KV block once, rotated so the first slot is not block 0."""
+    order = torch.roll(torch.arange(sk // block, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32), 1)
+    return order.expand(batch, heads, sq // block, -1).contiguous()
+

+def _launch(block):
+    interface = importlib.import_module("cudnn.block_sparse_attention._interface")
+    return getattr(interface, f"_bsa_attn_fwd_sm90_fp8_blk{block}")
+

+def _quantized(batch=1, heads=1, sq=64, sk=192):
+    from cudnn.block_sparse_attention._fp8_quant import _quantize_sage_bhsd
+
+    return _quantize_sage_bhsd(*_inputs(batch, heads, sq, sk), v_layout="bhds")

+def _assert_reference(block, tensors, ids, count, beta=128**-0.5, atol=0.003, rtol=0.015):
+    out, lse = _launch(block)(*tensors, ids, count, beta)
+    ref, lse_ref = _online_reference(*tensors, ids, count, beta, block_size=block)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out.double(), ref, atol=atol, rtol=rtol)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(lse.double(), lse_ref, atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-5)
+    return out, lse
+
+
+def _online_reference(q, k, v, qs, ks, vs, indices, count, beta, block_size=64):
+    """Simulate online P rounding; host reads here are reference-only."""
+    b, h, sq, _ = q.shape
+    output = torch.empty_like(q, dtype=torch.float64)
+    lse = torch.empty((b, h, sq), device=q.device, dtype=torch.float64)
+    ids = indices.cpu().tolist()
+    for bi in range(b):
+        for hi in range(h):
+            for qb in range(sq // block_size):
+                rows = slice(qb * block_size, (qb + 1) * block_size)
+                maximum = torch.full((block_size, 1), -math.inf, device=q.device, dtype=torch.float64)
+                total = torch.zeros_like(maximum)
+                acc = torch.zeros((block_size, 128), device=q.device, dtype=torch.float64)
+                for slot in reversed(range(count)):
+                    block = ids[bi][hi][qb][slot]
+                    cols = slice(block * block_size, (block + 1) * block_size)
+                    x = q[bi, hi, rows].double() @ k[bi, hi, cols].double().T
+                    x *= qs[bi, hi, rows].double()[:, None]
+                    x *= ks[bi, hi, block * (block_size // 16) : (block + 1) * (block_size // 16)].double().repeat_interleave(16)[None, :]
+                    x *= beta
+                    new_max = torch.maximum(maximum, x.amax(-1, keepdim=True))
+                    alpha = (maximum - new_max).exp()
+                    p = (x - new_max).exp() * 256
+                    acc = acc * alpha + p.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).double() @ v[bi, hi, :, cols].double().T
+                    total = total * alpha + p.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+                    maximum = new_max
+                output[bi, hi, rows] = acc / total * vs[hi].double()[None, :]
+                lse[bi, hi, rows] = (maximum + total.log() - math.log(256)).squeeze(-1)
+    return output, lse

+def _assert_k_codes_at_midpoints(actual, scaled_reference):
+    # FP32 mean reduction order can flip an exact FP8 tie. Require a single
+    # adjacent code AND evidence from the unquantized reference, rather than
+    # a fixed absolute tolerance (one E4M3 step is not always <= 4).
+    reference = scaled_reference.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    mismatch = actual.view(torch.uint8) != reference.view(torch.uint8)
+    actual_codes = actual.view(torch.uint8)[mismatch].short()
+    reference_codes = reference.view(torch.uint8)[mismatch].short()
+    delta = (actual_codes - reference_codes).abs()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(delta, torch.ones_like(delta), rtol=0, atol=0)
+    midpoint = (actual.float()[mismatch] + reference.float()[mismatch]) * 0.5
+    distance = (scaled_reference[mismatch] - midpoint).abs()
+    bound = 4 * torch.finfo(torch.float32).eps * midpoint.abs().clamp_min(1)
+    assert torch.all(distance <= bound), "K-code mismatch away from an FP8 midpoint"

+    k[..., 0] = (torch.arange(sk, device="cuda") // 128).float() * 0.625 - 4.0
+    v = torch.randn_like(k) * 0.25
+    q, k, v = (x.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn) for x in (q, k, v))
+    qs = torch.ones(batch, heads, sq, device="cuda")
+    ks = torch.ones(batch, heads, math.ceil(sk / 16), device="cuda")
+    vs = torch.ones(heads, 128, device="cuda")
+    quantized = (q, k, v, qs, ks, vs)
+    # Keep the full GPU workload under racecheck without instrumenting the
+    # oracle's many GEMMs, which can exhaust the sanitizer's host memory.
+    reference_inputs = tuple(t.cpu() for t in dequantize(quantized))
+    nq, nk = math.ceil(sq / 128), math.ceil(sk / 128)
+    # The kernel walks these indices in reverse: nonzero query rows see
+    # increasing logits, while zero query rows keep the same normalization.
+    index = torch.arange(nk - 1, nk - topk - 1, -1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    index = index.expand(batch, heads, nq, topk).contiguous()
+    sizes = (sk - torch.arange(nk, device="cuda") * 128).clamp(0, 128).int()
+    for counts in ((17, 0, 7, 3), (0, 17, 3, 7)):
+        nums = torch.tensor(counts, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+        nums = nums.repeat(math.ceil(batch * heads * nq / 4))[: batch * heads * nq]
+        nums = nums.reshape(batch, heads, nq)
+        selected = index.masked_fill(torch.arange(topk, device="cuda") >= nums[..., None], 0x3FFFFFFF)
+        out = bsa_fp8_fwd(
+            *quantized,
+            selected,
+            topk,
+            1.0,
+            sparse_block_size=128,
+            block_sizes=sizes,
+            q2k_block_nums=nums,
+        )
+        ref = sparse_reference(*reference_inputs, selected.cpu(), topk, nums.cpu(), sizes.cpu(), scale=1.0).to(out.device)
+        assert_accuracy(out, ref)
+        for _ in range(3):
+            repeat = bsa_fp8_fwd(
+                *quantized,
+                selected,
+                topk,
+                1.0,
+                sparse_block_size=128,
+                block_sizes=sizes,
+                q2k_block_nums=nums,
+            )
+            assert torch.equal(out, repeat)
+

+    import cutlass
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cudnn.block_sparse_attention._fp8_quant import _SageFp8Quantizer
+
+    sm120 = os.environ["CUTE_DSL_ARCH"] == "sm_120a"
+    tensors = [
+        cute.runtime.make_fake_compact_tensor(dtype, (cute.sym_int(),), stride_order=(0,), assumed_align=16)
+        for dtype in [cutlass.BFloat16] * 3 + [cutlass.Float8E4M3FN] * 3 + [cutlass.Float32] * 6
+    ]
+    cute.compile(

+        *[cutlass.Int32(x) for x in (2, 3, 129, 259, 2, 4)],

**Move the large sweeps out of the module-wide L0 level.**

The module-level `pytestmark` applies `pytest.mark.L0` to every test in the file. The default CI smoke run therefore includes these tests:

- `test_split_dynamic_metadata`: 32 parametrized cells. Each cell runs three shapes. The cells cover 32 distinct `(has_block_nums, block_sizes_mode, kv_splits)` compile-cache keys of the warp-specialized kernel.
- `test_fp8_blk128_native_tails_and_metadata`: 8 cells. Each cell runs four shapes.
- `test_fp8_blk128_scales_and_online_rescaling`: 5 cells with `sk=4353`.
- `test_offline_compile` and `test_sm120_blocked_v_offline_compile`: each test starts a subprocess that compiles several kernel variants, with a 240 s timeout.

The module also carries `gpu_exclusive` and `xdist_group(name="gpu_exclusive")`. With `--dist loadgroup`, every one of these cells runs on one worker. The L0 wall time then grows with the full sweep.

1. Keep one representative cell per contract at L0. For example, keep one `kv_splits > 1` case with variable counts and `sizes_mode=3`, and one tails case.

3. Pytest adds markers together, so a per-test `L1` marker does not remove the module-level `L0`. Remove `L0` from `pytestmark` and mark each test with its own level.

+        lane = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % 32
+        value = Float32(0.0)
+        if lane < 8:
+            scale_idx = cutlass.min(key_block * 8 + lane, mKScale.shape[2] - 1)
+            value = mKScale[batch_idx, head_idx, scale_idx]
+        return value
+
+    # for both softmax0 and softmax1 warp group
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def valid_block_size(
+        self,
+        mBlockSizes: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        batch_idx: Int32,
+        head_idx: Int32,
+        key_block: Int32,
+        seqlen_k: Int32,
+    ) -> Int32:
+        size = cutlass.min(cutlass.max(seqlen_k - key_block * 128, Int32(0)), Int32(128))
+        if const_expr(self.has_block_sizes):
+            if const_expr(self.block_sizes_mode == 1):
+                size = cutlass.min(size, mBlockSizes[key_block])
+            elif const_expr(self.block_sizes_mode == 2):
+                size = cutlass.min(size, mBlockSizes[batch_idx, key_block])
+            else:
+                size = cutlass.min(size, mBlockSizes[batch_idx, head_idx, key_block])
+        return size
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def correction_rescale(
+        self,
+        thr_mma: cute.ThrMma,
+        tOtO: cute.Tensor,
+        tidx: Int32,
+        scale: Float32,
+    ):
+        """Rescale intermediate attention results based on softmax normalization factor.
+
+        This method performs a crucial correction step in the attention computation pipeline.
+        When processing attention in blocks, the softmax normalization factors may change
+        as new blocks are processed. This method rescales previously computed partial
+        output values to account for updated normalization factors.
+
+        The implementation uses efficient tensor memory operations to:
+        1. Load existing partial attention output from tensor memory
+        2. Apply the scaling factor to all elements
+        3. Store the rescaled results back to tensor memory
+        """
+        tOcO = thr_mma.partition_C(cute.make_identity_tensor(self.mma_tiler_pv[:2]))
+        corr_tile_size = self.correction_tile_size
+        tmem_load_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(tcgen05.copy.Ld32x32bOp(tcgen05.copy.Repetition(corr_tile_size)), self.pv_acc_dtype)
+        tmem_store_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            tcgen05.copy.St32x32bOp(tcgen05.copy.Repetition(corr_tile_size)),
+            self.pv_acc_dtype,
+        )
+        tOtO_i = cute.composition(tOtO, cute.make_layout((self.m_block_size, corr_tile_size)))
+        tOcO_i = cute.composition(tOcO, cute.make_layout((self.m_block_size, corr_tile_size)))
+        thr_tmem_load = tcgen05.make_tmem_copy(tmem_load_atom, tOtO_i).get_slice(tidx)
+        thr_tmem_store = tcgen05.make_tmem_copy(tmem_store_atom, tOtO_i).get_slice(tidx)
+        tOtO_t2r = thr_tmem_load.partition_S(tOtO_i)
+        tOrO_t2r_shape = thr_tmem_load.partition_D(tOcO_i).shape
+        tOtO_r2t = thr_tmem_store.partition_D(tOtO_i)
+
+        frg_count = self.head_dim_v_padded // corr_tile_size
+        tOrO_frg = cute.make_rmem_tensor((tOrO_t2r_shape, frg_count), self.pv_acc_dtype)

+        self.sched_stages = 1

+    def _setup_attributes(self):

+        - Configures pipeline stages for softmax, correction, and epilogue operations
+        """
+
+        smem_size_q = self.q_stage * self.m_block_size * self.head_dim_padded * self.q_dtype.width // 8
+        smem_size_o = self.s_stage * self.m_block_size * self.head_dim_v_padded * self.o_dtype.width // 8
+        smem_size_q_o = smem_size_q + smem_size_o
+        smem_size_k_per_stage = self.n_block_size * self.head_dim_padded * self.k_dtype.width // 8
+        smem_size_v_per_stage = self.n_block_size * self.head_dim_v_padded * self.v_dtype.width // 8
+        smem_size_kv_per_stage = max(smem_size_k_per_stage, smem_size_v_per_stage)
+        self.kv_stage = (224 * 1024 - smem_size_q_o - 16384) // smem_size_kv_per_stage
+        # self.s_stage is defined in __init__ (always 2)
+        assert self.s_stage >= self.q_stage
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        mQ: cute.Tensor,  # (b, h, s_q, d)
+        mK: cute.Tensor,  # (b, h, s_k, d)
+        mV: cute.Tensor,  # (b, h, s_k, dv)
+        mO: cute.Tensor,  # (b, h, s_q, dv)
+        mLSE: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mQScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mVScale: cute.Tensor,
+        softmax_scale: Float32,
+        mBlockIndex: cute.Tensor,  # (batch, heads, num_q_blocks, max_kv_blocks), int32
+        mBlockSizes: cute.Tensor,  # (num_kv_blocks,), int32
+        block_sparse_num: Int32,  # runtime scalar >= 1; odd counts use a masked phantom block
+        mBlockNums: Optional[cute.Tensor],  # (batch, heads, num_q_blocks), int32 or None
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """Execute the Fused Multi-Head Attention operation on the provided tensors.
+
+        This method prepares the input tensors for processing, validates their shapes and types,
+        configures the computation parameters, and launches the CUDA kernel.
+
+        The method handles:
+        1. Tensor layout transformations for specific memory access patterns
+        2. Validation of tensor shapes and data types
+        3. Initialization of hardware-specific parameters and memory layouts
+        4. Configuration of TMA (Tensor Memory Access) operations
+        5. Grid and work scheduling computation
+        6. Kernel launch with appropriate parameters
+        """
+        assert (mLSE is not None) == (self.num_splits > 1), "Split producers require LSE"
+        # setup static attributes before smem/grid/tma computation
+        self.q_dtype = mQ.element_type
+        self.k_dtype = mK.element_type
+        self.v_dtype = mV.element_type
+        self.o_dtype = mO.element_type
+        assert self.q_dtype == cutlass.Float8E4M3FN
+        assert self.o_dtype == (Float32 if self.num_splits > 1 else cutlass.BFloat16)
+        mQ, mK, mV, mO = [assume_tensor_aligned(t) for t in (mQ, mK, mV, mO)]
+        # Kernel boundary contract is BHSD. Convert (B, H, S, D) to
+        # the mainloop/TMA-friendly (S, D, H, B) view internally.
+        Q_layout_transpose = [2, 3, 1, 0]
+        mQ = cute.make_tensor(mQ.iterator, cute.select(mQ.layout, mode=Q_layout_transpose))
+        # (s_k, d, h_k, b_k)
+        KV_layout_transpose = [2, 3, 1, 0]
+        mK, mV = [cute.make_tensor(t.iterator, cute.select(t.layout, mode=KV_layout_transpose)) for t in (mK, mV)]
+        O_layout_transpose = [2, 3, 1, 0]
+        LSE_layout_transpose = [2, 1, 0]
+        num_splits = Int32(self.num_splits)
+        mO = cute.make_tensor(mO.iterator, cute.select(mO.layout, mode=O_layout_transpose))
+        mLSE = cute.make_tensor(mLSE.iterator, cute.select(mLSE.layout, mode=LSE_layout_transpose)) if const_expr(mLSE is not None) else None
+        # (s, d, h, b) -> (d, s, h, b)
+        V_layout_transpose = [1, 0, 2, 3]
+        mV = cute.make_tensor(mV.iterator, cute.select(mV.layout, mode=V_layout_transpose))
+
+        # check type consistency
+        if const_expr(self.q_dtype != self.k_dtype):
+            raise TypeError(f"Type mismatch: {self.q_dtype} != {self.k_dtype}")
+        if const_expr(self.q_dtype != self.v_dtype):
+            raise TypeError(f"Type mismatch: {self.q_dtype} != {self.v_dtype}")
+        self._setup_attributes()
+        q_major_mode = OperandMajorMode.K
+        k_major_mode = OperandMajorMode.K
+        v_major_mode = OperandMajorMode.MN
+        self.o_layout = LayoutEnum.from_tensor(mO)
+        # the intermediate tensor p is from tmem & mK-major
+        p_source = tcgen05.OperandSource.TMEM
+        p_major_mode = OperandMajorMode.K
+        tiled_mma_qk = sm100_utils_basic.make_trivial_tiled_mma(
+            self.q_dtype,
+            self.k_dtype,
+            q_major_mode,
+            k_major_mode,
+            self.qk_acc_dtype,
+            tcgen05.CtaGroup.ONE,
+            self.mma_tiler_qk[:2],
+        )

+            self.q_dtype,
+            self.v_dtype,
+            p_major_mode,
+            v_major_mode,
+            self.pv_acc_dtype,
+            tcgen05.CtaGroup.ONE,
+            self.mma_tiler_pv[:2],
+            p_source,
+        )
+
+        self.epi_tile = (self.m_block_size, self.head_dim_v_padded)

+        sK_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_b(tiled_mma_qk, self.mma_tiler_qk, self.k_dtype, self.kv_stage)
+        tP_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_a(tiled_mma_pv, self.mma_tiler_pv, self.q_dtype, self.s_stage)
+        sV_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_b(tiled_mma_pv, self.mma_tiler_pv, self.v_dtype, self.kv_stage)
+        sO_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_epi(self.o_dtype, self.o_layout, self.epi_tile, self.s_stage)
+        self.tma_copy_bytes = {
+            name: cute.size_in_bytes(mX.element_type, cute.select(layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]))
